claims.claim: Equilibrium ambient-pressure conventional 300 K superconductivity deserves a low portfolio prior after massive EPC/ML search, but is not ruled out by theorem.
Mg2RhH6 is worth a controlled decompression/retention campaign because its superconducting parent phase and formation pathway are experimentally established.
Quenchability should be optimized separately from pairing scale.
Mg/Al/Fe hydrides are a falsifiable ambient carrier-engineering lane if disorder, magnetism and H-vacancy compensation are handled explicitly.
Pressure/composition/isotope trajectories near quantum structural criticality deserve explicit screening in hydrides.
Cheap physics descriptors may reduce wasted DFPT labels but must not become surrogate proof of high Tc.
